issue.title: fix(tool): edit_file line operations drop the final newline and convert CRLF files to LF

steps:
Use the shell and Python pathlib.Path to create settings.ini with write_bytes(b'[app]
name = demo
mode = debug
port = 8080
workers = 4
'). Create its parent directory if needed. Read it with read_file.
Use edit_file delete_lines to remove the mode = debug line from settings.ini. Preserve every other byte and the final newline.
expected: Deleting one line preserves CRLF and the final newline of unaffected content.
defect: Line-operation edits rebuild the whole file with LF separators and drop its final newline.

fault location.explanation: DeleteLines and sibling operations collect content.lines() and join with a hardcoded LF; Rust lines removes CRLF terminators and final-newline information. c51b6a7e preserves the original byte spans.

Root cause: DeleteLines and sibling operations collect content.lines() and join with a hardcoded LF; Rust lines removes CRLF terminators and final-newline information. c51b6a7e preserves the original byte spans.

_meta.notes: Exact issue bytes. The tool line indices are zero-based in the report, so mode is index 2. Confirm the actual tool argument contract rather than prescribing the wrong index.
